Date: 24-07-2026
NOTICE
Provisional Shortlisting Status of Candidates for the Post of Incubation Manager against
Advertisement No. Newgen/IEDC/KU/2026/15 dated 11-07-2026.
It is hereby notified for the information of all candidates who applied for the contractual position of
Incubation Manager in response to Advertisement No. NewGen/IEDC/KU/2026/15; dated 11-07-2026
that the provisional shortlisting status of the applicants is enclosed as Annexure-I.
All concerned candidates are advised to carefully verify the status/observations recorded against their names.
Discrepancy, if any, may be brought into the notice by or before 26th July, 2026. Candidates whose
applications have been marked with deficiencies are required to submit the relevant documentary evidence
through email at newgeniedc.ku@gmail.com on or before 26-07-2026.
It is further notified that the candidature of any applicant shall remain purely provisional. If any discrepancy,
concealment of facts, or adverse report is detected or received at any stage of the selection process, the
candidature of the concerned candidate shall be liable to cancellation without any further notice.
Sd/- Coordinator
NewGen IEDC
University of Kashmir
